raw_directive: Audit and design the sports and recreation mechanics. 1. Evaluate population needs for sports and the existence/types of sports buildings. 2. Design financing and management models: local government ownership, private commercial models, privatization mechanics, and subsidized models. 3. Model the impact of sports on population health, specifically overall life expectancy and healthy life years. 4. Implement seasonality and climate modifiers: open-air facilities must close or drastically lose efficiency in cold winters or extreme heat, while indoor facilities (sports halls, swimming pools) function year-round.
